owner.description: Sam Rivera, founder and CEO of Acme Health (software for medical device companies)

client.means: an existing customer or their project: deliverables, invoices, reviews, support, contracts

prospect.means: a sales conversation you are pursuing: a lead, demo, proposal, RFP, or a prospect replying

internal.means: a colleague writing to you as a person about internal work
internal.not: Automated posts from internal tools (Confluence, Jira, scheduled job summaries, monitoring) are notification or digest, not internal. A colleague writing about a specific customer's project, deliverable or invoice is client, not internal.

investor.means: a genuine VC firm, bank or established financial institution writing about your company
investor.not: Lenders, financing brokers and capital-raise helpers are capital_pitch, not investor.

partner.means: an existing vendor, partner, advisor, lawyer or accountant you already work with

action_needed.means: asks you to do something specific: sign, approve, complete, confirm, pay, reply by a date
action_needed.not: A signature request or 'action required' email is action_needed even when automated.

notification.means: transactional or system mail: alerts, receipts, calendar, meeting reminders, tool activity, security notices

digest.means: an automated periodic summary of activity you are part of: daily/weekly digests, recaps, scheduled reports

newsletter.means: bulk marketing or editorial mail: newsletters, product announcements, promotions, webinar or event marketing

pr_marketing.means: your own PR and visibility: articles, podcast or interview invitations, speaking slots, conferences in your field
pr_marketing.not: Events in your field are pr_marketing even when they sell sponsorship or 'meetings with decision makers'; events outside it are vendor_pitch.

vendor_pitch.means: a person's unsolicited cold sales outreach: agencies, lead-gen, dev shops, consultants, tools
vendor_pitch.not: Cold outreach dressed up as a reply ('Re:', 'following up', 'circling back') with no real thread is still vendor_pitch, but a reply in a thread the owner has actually written in is never vendor_pitch.

capital_pitch.means: unsolicited capital solicitation: lenders, revenue-based financing, cash advances, raise helpers, brokers

other.means: anything else, or not enough information to tell
